items.title: [HOAKS] - VAKSIN COVID-19 MEMILIKI CHIP YANG DAPAT MELACAK KEBERADAAN ORANG
items.snippet_en: Jala Hoaks Jakarta states that the claim of COVID-19 vaccines containing chips to track vaccinated individuals is a hoax. Barcodes on vaccine products are for tracking distribution, not people.

items.title: Covid Queries: Altered DNA and microchips
items.snippet_en: Dr. Martin Herrmann of Mayo Clinic Health System confirms there is no microchip in the vaccine and no way for it to track people or gather personal information.

items.title: Vaksin Covid-19 Punya Chip untuk Lacak Orang? Itu Disinformasi!
items.snippet_en: Komdigi, referencing the Ministry of Communication and Informatics (Kominfo), states that the claim of COVID-19 vaccines containing chips to track people is false.

items.title: Medfact: Ada Chip di Vaksin Sinovac?
items.snippet_en: KlikDokter addresses the rumor of microchips in Sinovac vaccines, stating it is a hoax. Similar claims were circulating in the US, often linked to Bill Gates.

items.title: HOAX : Vaksin COVID-19 Mengandung Mikrocip Magnetis
items.snippet_en: The Indonesian Ministry of Health (Kemenkes) explicitly states that the narrative claiming COVID-19 vaccines contain magnetic microchips is untrue and urges the public not to be influenced.
A Facebook post from the Ministry of Communication and Informatics directly refutes the claim, stating that no chips or barcodes are implanted in COVID-19 vaccines to track people.
